== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to Dwayna players in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in certain repeatable [[Wintersday]] quests. 

== Notes ==
* This skill is only available to players during Wintersday events.
* This skill is used by [[Snowman (summon)|Snowman]] from summoning stones.

== Trivia ==
* The animation of this skill looks like the occasional animation of a snowman from a [[Snowman Summoner]].
* Prior to Wintersday 2010, this skill was a [[Skill (skill type)|Skill]] instead of Spell.
